outcome: FAILED — CUDA out of memory during the first forward pass

failure.phase: forward pass, before the first optimizer step
failure.note: SDPA is where the exception surfaced, NOT what caused it. SDPA receives attn_mask=None and is_causal=True, so no b*h*s*s matrix is materialised; it was simply the next sizeable allocation after the DeltaNet layers had already consumed the card.

measured_demand_gib.method: torch.autograd.graph.saved_tensors_hooks on CPU, attributing every retained tensor to the module that created it. Device-independent: shapes and dtypes do not depend on CUDA.

root_cause: The Gated DeltaNet activation term was not modelled at all. The estimator treated all 16 layers as generic transformer blocks scaling with hidden_size and intermediate_size. In reality the 12 DeltaNet layers retained 66% of all activations across 5,244 saved tensors (vs 86 for all four attention layers combined), because transformers' pure-torch torch_chunk_gated_delta_rule (a) force-upcasts to fp32, defeating fp16 autocast in 12 of 16 layers, and (b) runs a 63-iteration Python loop that clones and retains O(chunk_size^2) tensors per chunk. The loop term alone is v_heads*85344*4/chunk_size = 64 KB per token per layer, larger than the estimator's entire previous activation budget.

deltanet_measurement.what: retained activation bytes per token per DeltaNet layer, forward pass
deltanet_measurement.how: torch.autograd.graph.saved_tensors_hooks, attributing every tensor the autograd graph retains to the module that created it. Device-independent: tensor shapes and dtypes do not depend on CUDA.
deltanet_measurement.caveat: this describes the pure-torch REFERENCE path. Installing `fla` (flash-linear-attention) replaces it with a fused kernel whose retained footprint is far smaller, and these numbers no longer apply.

resolution: configs/experiments/t4_level2_100m_ckpt.yaml — same 94.48M architecture, same 3:1 hybrid layout, same sequence length, same effective batch. Gradient checkpointing ON (measured 67x reduction in retained activations) and micro batch 8->4 with accumulation 2->4 for margin.
preserved_as: This configuration is deliberately kept unchanged as the failed baseline. It is a real experimental result: it is what a 94.48M hybrid model costs on a T4 without gradient checkpointing under the reference DeltaNet kernel.
